title: Convert Sorted Array to Binary Search Tree
statement:
Given an integer array nums where the elements are sorted in ascending order, convert it to a height-balanced binary search tree.

A height-balanced binary tree is a binary tree in which the depth of the two subtrees of every node never differs by more than one.

Print the Level-order traversal of the built tree.
inputFormat:
Line 1: an integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers, sorted in ascending order.
outputFormat: Space-separated strings mapping the level-order traversal of the built BST.

examples.explanation: Building BST from the middle node.
Either [1, null, 3] or [3, 1] is valid, assuming right bias on mid calculations.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
nums = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Write logic: Find mid, assign to root, recursion on left and right slices.
